name: Parking Fine Refund Confirmation
description: Confirmation email sent when a parking fine payment is refunded
subject: Refund Confirmation - Parking Fine #{fine_id}
body_html:
Refund Confirmation

Dear {student_name},

This confirms that a refund has been processed for your parking fine payment.

Refund Details

Fine ID:#{fine_id}
Refund Amount:£{amount}
Original Payment Method:{payment_method}
Refund Date:{refund_date}
Refund Reference:{refund_id}

Note: The refund will be credited to your original payment method within 5-10 business days.

If you have any questions about this refund, please contact the Parking Management Office.

Best regards,
Parking Management

student_name.description: Name of the student receiving the refund

fine_id.description: Unique identifier for the parking fine
